title: Creamy Risotto Cake with Caramelized Daikon and Italian Sausage
description: A French-inspired risotto cake with savory caramelized daikon and spicy Italian sausage, perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: 2. Cook the Italian sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
3. In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked risotto, eggs, bread crumbs, and grated cheese. Mix well.
4. Add the cooked Italian sausage to the risotto mixture and mix until combined.
5. Divide the mixture into 6 equal portions and shape each into a round cake.
6. Place the cakes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each.
7. Drizzle the tops with melted butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
9. Meanwhile, slice the daikon into 1/4-inch thick rounds and caramelize in a skillet with butter until tender and lightly browned.
10. Serve the risotto cakes with caramelized daikon on top and a side of marinara sauce, if desired.
